summary: R-2 из ревью T-0759 (fake-green, класс T-0715): src/__tests__/processes-read-visibility.test.ts's fake pg pool gated its ACTOR_ACTIVE simulation purely by SQL query SHAPE + the deactivatedSlugs fixture list — it never checked whether the query TEXT actually carried the ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL (deactivated_at IS NULL) predicate. A mutant that deletes `AND ${ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL}` from isInstanceParticipant/isInstanceParticipantBatch's point-lookup (process-projection.ts) stayed invisible to the unit suite — all 28 tests green — meaning real coverage for this predicate was live-PG-only (ci/checks/db/processes-read-visibility.db.test.ts) plus the fitness gate, not the fast unit tier. Fix: the fake pool now imports the SAME ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL constant the prod code imports and checks `text.includes(ACTOR_ACTIVE_SQL)` before applying deactivatedSlugs filtering — mirroring real Postgres semantics (a deactivated employee's row still exists; only a WHERE clause naming the predicate excludes it). Prod code (process-projection.ts) is untouched by the committed diff — it was only mutated transiently, twice, to prove RED, then reverted with `git checkout --` (no git stash used, per task constraint).

security_notes: This task changes ZERO production authorization logic — it strengthens a test double's fidelity to the SQL it fakes. No new attack surface; the existing live-PG suite (ci/checks/db/processes-read-visibility.db.test.ts) remains the ground-truth security coverage for the ACTOR_ACTIVE predicate on real Postgres — this task adds a FAST unit-tier tripwire that now actually detects the same class of regression, rather than duplicating live-PG's authority.

The fake pool's new `carriesActiveGate` check is symmetric: it does not introduce a new false-deny for an ACTIVE actor whose query happens to omit the predicate for some OTHER reason — see spec §5 point 2. Every pre-existing (non-deactivated-actor) test in the file stays green with the fix in place, confirming no over-tightening.
